name: track segment elements
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以相邻钢轨垫层之间轨道区段构造的离散单元。
usage_note: 在该文周期轨道表示中使用，不直接等同于桥梁有限元单元。

complete_examples.text: The railway track is assumed to be a periodic structure assembled by track segment elements (TSEs) [33] representing arbitrary track section between two adjacent rail pads.
